items.prompt: 哪一句结构完整，适合作为段落中心句？

choices.label: A quiet place helps me study more effectively.
choices.why: 句子有明确主语和谓语，意思完整。

choices.label: Because a quiet place near my home.
choices.why: because 引出的从句没有主句。

choices.label: Studying more effectively in the evening.
choices.why: 只有动名词短语，没有限定谓语。

items.text: I usually prepare my bag before I go to bed.
items.prompt: 哪一句最适合作为具体理由？

choices.label: This saves time because I do not need to look for things in the morning.
choices.why: 直接解释前一行为带来的好处。

choices.label: Many bags are made in different colours.
choices.why: 谈颜色，与准备书包的理由无关。

choices.label: The morning was yesterday.
choices.why: 语义不通，也不支持中心句。

items.prompt: 哪一句正确表达“课程很难，但很有用”？

choices.label: The course is difficult, but it is useful.
choices.why: but 正确连接相反的评价。

choices.label: The course is difficult because it is useful.
choices.why: 这里不是明确的原因关系。

choices.label: But the course difficult and useful.
choices.why: 缺少系动词，结构不完整。

items.prompt: 哪组顺序最像一个清楚的短段落？① Therefore, I can start work calmly. ② I make a short plan every morning. ③ It tells me which task to do first.

choices.label: ② → ③ → ①
choices.why: 先给行为，再解释计划作用，最后给结果。

choices.label: ① → ② → ③
choices.why: Therefore 不能在原因出现前先给结果。

choices.label: ③ → ① → ②
choices.why: It 在 plan 出现前没有清楚指代。

items.prompt: 任务要求“说明迟到、给出原因并道歉”。哪项回应最完整？

choices.label: I am sorry that I will be late because my train has been delayed.
choices.why: 迟到、原因和道歉三项都有。

choices.label: The train is usually fast and comfortable.
choices.why: 没有说明迟到，也没有道歉。

choices.label: I will be late. See you.
choices.why: 说明了迟到，但缺少原因和道歉。
